items: KANO STATE (PSI 9.1): Clears ₦37Bn of ₦48Bn Gratuity Backlog with Online Pension App, Launches Anti-Graft Monitoring for 484 Ward Ambulances & Opens TRAN Textile Conference
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.9): Launches United Nigeria Airlines Jos–Owerri/Kano Flights, Advances €42M AFD Water Rehabilitation & Deploys HOPE Health Data Tools
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.7): Commences Construction of 26 AGILE Secondary Schools Across 3 Senatorial Districts & Develops 2027–2029 M&E Improvement Plan with UNICEF
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.5): Schedules Ijegun–Ijagemo Road Commissioning, Launches Night Waste Evacuation with 10+ LAWMA Regions & Convenes LASISMA Retreat
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 8.3): Gov. Soludo Presents ₦893.44Bn 2027 Appropriation Bill ('Solution 2.0') with 77.53% Capital Expenditure
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.1): Gov. Otti Advances PPP Partnership with China Harbour Engineering Company (CHEC) for Proposed Abia Sea Port City
YOBE STATE (PSI 7.9): Gov. Buni Presents ₦532.27Bn 2027 Budget Proposal ('Consolidation, Sustainability and Inclusive Growth') to State Assembly
ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov. Mbah Commences Revitalisation of Dormant State Agro-Industrial Assets Including Sunrise Flour Mills & Vegetable Oil Plants
BORNO STATE (PSI 7.5): VP Shettima & Gov. Zulum Commission Reconstructed 180-Metre NEDC Fort (Galtimari) Bridge in Jere LGA
EDO STATE (PSI 7.3): Oil & Gas Ministry Engages Dubril Oil on 2027 Work Programme, Wastewater Compliance & Host Community Trust Projects
BAUCHI STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov. Bala Mohammed Outlines Proposed 2027 'Budget of Consolidation' Prioritising Project Completion, Gratuities & Security
KATSINA STATE (PSI 7.0): Gov. Radda Establishes Investigative Committee & Suspends Official Engagements of Emir of Daura Over Assault Allegations
OYO STATE (PSI 6.9): Gov. Makinde Calls for Socio-Political Reset at Book Launch, Opens 2026 Pacesetter Fair & Advances 3.79km Akala Road
TARABA STATE (PSI 6.8): Gov. Kefas Holds Follow-Up Talks with Works Minister Umahi in Abuja to Accelerate Wukari Road, Namnai & Ibi Bridges
DELTA STATE (PSI 6.7): Gov. Oborevwori Visits Uduere Community in Ughelli North, Condemns Killings & Orders Arrest of Perpetrators
RIVERS STATE (PSI 6.6): Gov. Fubara Closes 2026 Batch C Stream II NYSC Camp in Tai LGA, Charges Corps Members on Integrity & Skill Acquisition
KADUNA STATE (PSI 6.5): Information Commissioner Visits Fire-Damaged FRCN Kaduna Station, Pledges Support & Urges Preventive Fire Upgrades
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 6.4): Gov. Sule Chairs State Security Council Meeting & Welcomes Newly Deployed Police Commissioner and NSCDC Commandant
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 6.3): Ministry of Rural Infrastructure Engages Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) on CDO Capacity Building Partnership
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 6.1): Health Ministry Delegation Participates in 67th National Council on Health to Align State UHC Reforms
OSUN STATE (PSI 6.0): Gov. Adeleke Hosts Osun Youth Representatives at Pre-Inauguration Dinner on Innovation & Governance Inclusion

KANO (PSI 9.1): Gov. Abba Kabir Yusuf's administration confirmed paying ₦37 billion out of ₦48 billion in inherited gratuity and deceased workers' entitlements (shifting to monthly payments with an online pension verification app and targeting April 2027 for the remaining ₦11bn); ICPC, EFCC, and PCACC pledged joint anti-corruption monitoring of the 484 ward tricycle ambulances; and Deputy Gov. Murtala Garo opened the 13th TRAN International Conference on AI-driven textile revival at Bayero University.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.9): United Nigeria Airlines commenced direct flight operations at Yakubu Gowon Airport, Jos, linking Plateau to Owerri and Kano under a state MoU; Jos Water Services Corporation reported 70–75% civil works completion on its €42 million AFD-backed Yakubu Gowon and Lamingo water plant rehabilitation; and the Ministry of Health handed over data tools and facility items under the World Bank-supported HOPE Project.

GOMBE (PSI 8.7): Gov. Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya's administration handed over sites to commence constructing 26 new public secondary schools (13 junior and 13 senior) equipped with laboratories and furniture under the AGILE Project, while the Ministry of Budget and Economic Planning convened a three-day workshop with UNICEF to develop Gombe's 2027–2029 Monitoring and Evaluation System Improvement Plan.

LAGOS (PSI 8.5): Gov. Babajide Sanwo-Olu scheduled the official handover of the newly completed Ijegun–Ijagemo Road; LAWMA commenced rapid night-time waste evacuation along the Isheri–Igando–LASU–Iba corridor while advancing decentralization into over 10 operational regions ahead of Detty December; and LASISMA held its 2026 staff retreat on orderly informal urban space management.

ANAMBRA (PSI 8.3): Gov. Chukwuma Soludo submitted the ₦893.435 billion 2027 Appropriation Bill ('Solution 2.0: Unlocking New Axis for Sustainable Prosperity') to the 8th Anambra Assembly - a 16.58% increase over 2026—allocating ₦692.66 billion (77.53%) to capital expenditure and ₦200.78 billion (22.47%) to recurrent spending.

ABIA (PSI 8.1): Gov. Alex Otti hosted a China Harbour Engineering Company Limited (CHEC) delegation led by MD Mr. Wang Jason to advance a full-lifecycle PPP partnership—from feasibility studies to construction—for the proposed Abia Sea Port City, noting parallel investor interest from Afreximbank.

YOBE (PSI 7.9): Gov. Mai Mala Buni presented a ₦532.271 billion 2027 budget proposal to the Yobe State House of Assembly allocating ₦288.426 billion (54.2%) to recurrent expenditure and ₦243.845 billion (45.8%) to capital projects across healthcare, education, agriculture, and youth/women empowerment.

ENUGU (PSI 7.6): Gov. Peter Mbah's administration initiated the reactivation of dormant state-owned agro-processing enterprises—including Sunrise Flour Mills, Enugu Vegetable Oil Products, and Enugu Palm Products—to drive agricultural value-chain productivity and support his eight-year sevenfold GDP expansion goal.

BORNO (PSI 7.5): Vice President Kashim Shettima, representing President Bola Tinubu alongside Gov. Babagana Umara Zulum and NEDC MD Mohammed Goni Alkali, commissioned the reconstructed 180-metre, 9-span Fort (Galtimari) Bridge in Jere LGA, restoring vital road links destroyed during the September 2024 flood.

EDO (PSI 7.3): Edo State Commissioner for Oil and Gas Resources Hon. Andrew Momodu engaged Dubril Oil Company Limited executives on submitting their 2027 work programme, enforcing wastewater environmental standards, and scaling Host Communities Development Trust (HCDT) interventions alongside Gelegele and Ovia field operations.

BAUCHI (PSI 7.2): Gov. Bala Mohammed convened a State Executive Council budget planning session outlining Bauchi's proposed 2027 Budget of Consolidation, prioritizing completion of ongoing roads, schools, and new emirate hospitals, settlement of outstanding gratuities, and operational funding for security agencies and vigilantes.

KATSINA (PSI 7.0): Gov. Dikko Umaru Radda constituted a formal investigative committee and suspended all official engagements and travels of the Emir of Daura, Alhaji Umar Farouk Umar, following viral sexual assault allegations involving a foreign tourist, pledging full implementation of the panel's findings.

OYO (PSI 6.9): Gov. Seyi Makinde advocated issue-based politics and rejected electoral violence at the University of Ibadan launch of nine books by Dr. Lasisi Olagunju, while the 2026 Pacesetter Trade Fair opened at Liberty Stadium and Lagelu LGA progressed reconstruction of the 3.79km Akala Road.

TARABA (PSI 6.8): Gov. Agbu Kefas met with Minister of Works Engr. David Umahi in Abuja to press for expedited federal execution on the Wukari Road as well as the Namnai and Ibi bridge projects critical to agricultural haulage in southern Taraba.

DELTA (PSI 6.7): Gov. Sheriff Oborevwori paid an on-the-spot assessment visit to Uduere community in Ughelli North LGA following the killing of over six persons, commending security agencies' rapid response and ordering the arrest and prosecution of all perpetrators regardless of political status.

RIVERS (PSI 6.6): Gov. Siminalayi Fubara, represented by Cabinet Bureau Permanent Secretary Dr. Promise Oguzie, closed the 2026 Batch C Stream II NYSC orientation camp at Nonwa-Gbam, Tai LGA, urging corps members to promote peace, acquire post-camp skills, and uphold electoral neutrality.

KADUNA (PSI 6.5): Kaduna State Commissioner for Information and Culture Malam Ahmed Maiyaki paid a solidarity visit to FRCN Kaduna following a fire incident affecting Spring FM and Karama FM studios, pledging Gov. Uba Sani's institutional support and urging stronger fire-prevention investments.

NASARAWA (PSI 6.4): Gov. Abdullahi Sule presided over the Nasarawa State Security Council meeting to review security operations and formally welcomed newly deployed Commissioner of Police CP Sheikh Mohammed Danko and NSCDC State Commandant Bala Bawa Bondinga.

ADAMAWA (PSI 6.3): The Adamawa State Ministry of Rural Infrastructure and Community Development engaged the Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) on a proposed partnership to train Community Development Officers and newly recruited staff in participatory planning, conflict management, and project M&E.

ZAMFARA (PSI 6.1): A Zamfara State Ministry of Health delegation led by Commissioner Dr. Nafisa Muhammad Maradun participated in the 67th National Council on Health in Nasarawa State to align state Universal Health Coverage and SWAp priorities with national resolutions.

OSUN (PSI 6.0): Gov. Ademola Adeleke hosted youth representatives across Osun State at a pre-inauguration dinner themed 'Building Opportunities, Driving Innovation and Shaping the Future Together' to explore expanded youth participation in state governance.
